corrections.request: this muligan has a flat wide head, whereas in the pictures i gave you, he has a narrow jaw and head
corrections.changes: Skull narrowed by 45% and lower jaw by 50%, including teeth, lips, mouth lining and forehead ridges. Depth, height, centerline skeleton, skin assignments and the idle action are retained.

corrections.request: THE jaw is even more narrow and pointed. the details are too few in yours
corrections.changes: Rebuilt the skull as a narrow tapering wedge and the lower jaw as slim mandibular rails meeting at one pointed chin, with a concave violet lining, 88 fine teeth, red tongue, nostril recesses and fine facial branches. Added 19 woven chest-cord layers with larger branching strands, 20 rounded shoulder nodules, rounded deltoids and forearm creases. Jaw rests open at 39 degrees and eases to 49 degrees in the same six-second idle. The 30-joint skeleton is retained, and planted-foot baking preserves authored limb bind roll.
